verification_note: Benchmarks compiled from public SaaS and B2B platform industry reports. Regional adjustments noted for EU context.

net_revenue_retention.source: OpenView 2025 SaaS Benchmarks — median NRR for usage-based B2B models is 110%
net_revenue_retention.note: NRR for usage-based B2B models; hardware-to-platform companies may see lower expansion due to physical device ceiling

ltv_to_cac_ratio.source: Bessemer Cloud Index — top-quartile B2B SaaS achieves 5x+ LTV:CAC
ltv_to_cac_ratio.note: Platform businesses with strong network effects can exceed 10x; hardware component reduces LTV:CAC vs pure SaaS

rule_of_40.source: Bessemer Venture Partners — Rule of 40 = revenue growth rate + profit margin
rule_of_40.note: Blended hardware+platform companies typically score 15-35 due to hardware margin drag

revenue_per_employee.source: KeyBanc 2025 SaaS Survey — median $180K for SaaS; adjusted for EUR and blended models
revenue_per_employee.note: Hardware companies typically 30-40% lower than pure SaaS due to field operations and manufacturing

gross_margin.source: KeyBanc 2025 SaaS Survey — median SaaS gross margin 75%; hardware margins from McKinsey B2B report
gross_margin.note: Blended margin depends on revenue mix; mature platforms shift toward 70%+ as hardware becomes smaller share

annual_recurring_revenue_growth.source: OpenView 2025 — median ARR growth for $5-20M ARR companies is 35%
annual_recurring_revenue_growth.note: IoT-platform hybrid companies typically grow 20-40% due to installation-dependent scaling

monthly_churn_rate.source: Bessemer Cloud Index — best-in-class logo churn <1% monthly for B2B
monthly_churn_rate.note: Hardware lock-in typically reduces churn vs pure SaaS; connected devices create switching costs

annual_churn_rate.source: OpenView 2025 SaaS Benchmarks — median annual logo churn 8-12% for B2B SaaS
annual_churn_rate.note: Device-dependent platforms see 5-8% annual churn due to physical switching costs

customer_acquisition_cost.source: KeyBanc 2025 — B2B platform CAC higher than pure SaaS due to longer sales cycles and field installation
customer_acquisition_cost.note: Includes hardware provisioning costs; channel/partner-driven acquisition can reduce CAC 30-50%

months_to_payback_cac.source: Bessemer Cloud Index — median payback period 15 months for B2B SaaS
months_to_payback_cac.note: Hardware component extends payback; recurring platform revenue eventually covers device cost

take_rate.source: McKinsey B2B Platform Economics — B2B marketplace take rates typically 5-15%, lower than B2C
take_rate.note: IoT data marketplaces can command higher take rates (15-25%) due to proprietary data value

gmv_growth_rate.source: McKinsey B2B Platform Economics — top B2B marketplaces grow GMV 30-50% annually
gmv_growth_rate.note: Device-dependent GMV growth constrained by physical installation capacity

api_adoption_rate.source: Gartner IoT Platform Market Guide — API adoption correlates strongly with platform stickiness
api_adoption_rate.note: Percentage of customers actively using API integrations; higher adoption = lower churn

partner_activation_rate.source: McKinsey B2B Platform Economics — channel partner activation within 90 days
partner_activation_rate.note: Percentage of signed partners generating revenue within 90 days; field service partners typically slower

device_uptime.source: Gartner IoT Platform Market Guide — enterprise IoT SLAs typically require 99.5%+
device_uptime.note: Uptime includes both device hardware and platform connectivity

cost_per_install.source: Industry analysis — varies by device complexity, geography, and installation requirements
cost_per_install.note: Includes technician time, travel, commissioning; EU costs typically 10-20% higher than US

mean_time_to_repair.source: Gartner IoT Platform Market Guide — MTTR benchmarks for connected device platforms
mean_time_to_repair.note: Remote diagnostics can reduce MTTR 40-60% compared to on-site-only repair

support_tickets_per_device_monthly.source: IoT industry benchmarks — proactive monitoring reduces tickets 50%+
support_tickets_per_device_monthly.note: AI-powered anomaly detection can proactively resolve issues before tickets are created

churn_risk.note: Using less than half of contracted tier

usage_vs_contracted_tier.note: Usage below 50% of tier is the strongest predictor of churn within 6 months

ai_forward.note: Already using AI tools, custom builds, Claude

ai_ready.note: Tech-savvy, APIs available, open to AI

ai_readiness_score.source: CRB Analyser internal assessments — validated across 50+ B2B platform analyses
ai_readiness_score.note: B2B platform companies typically score 55-75 (AI-ready to AI-forward) due to technical DNA

eu_context.gdpr_impact: IoT data collection requires explicit consent and DPA; affects device telemetry collection
eu_context.data_residency: EU customers often require data stored within EU borders — affects platform architecture
eu_context.pricing_adjustment: EU SaaS pricing typically 10-15% lower than US due to purchasing power and competition
eu_context.labor_costs: Western EU technical staff costs 15-25% higher than US equivalents; Eastern EU 30-40% lower

hourly_cost.note: Western European rates for B2B platform companies
